Veterans Benefits: Arizona taxes military retirement pay and does not provide a general statewide property-tax exemption for all veterans; eligibility-based property-tax relief and Arizona Department of Veterans' Services programs may apply. Verify current eligibility with the state before relying on a benefit.
Description: Mesa is a major East Valley city in Maricopa County offering extensive desert outdoor recreation, the Mesa Arts Center, a local VA clinic, and major defense and aerospace manufacturing led by Boeing's Apache helicopter plant. It features diverse suburban neighborhoods with hot desert summers and mild winters, while resident commentary notes car dependency, hot summer temperatures, and regional commuter traffic.
